extensions.title: Companion extensions
extensions.companion: Command Center works on its own. Spacesuit is its highly recommended companion for agent flavors and workflows.
extensions.core: Core monitoring only. No domain collectors are enabled.
extensions.legacy: Built-in optional panels remain enabled for compatibility. A Spacesuit flavor can replace them without changing core monitoring.
extensions.active: Spacesuit extensions — collected snapshots, independent of core monitoring.
extensions.configurationError: Extension selection could not be loaded. Core monitoring remains available.
extensions.none: No extensions selected. Core monitoring is still available.
extensions.staleNote: This snapshot is old; values below are not current.
extensions.unavailableNote: No current data is available for this extension. Core monitoring is unaffected.

projectBoard.error: Project snapshots could not be loaded. Try Refresh snapshots.
projectBoard.retained: Refresh failed. Showing previous snapshots; source data is not current.
projectBoard.noSources: No project sources configured. Command Center works on its own; add Spacesuit tracker adapters to populate this board.
projectBoard.empty: No projects reported. Check source freshness above.
projectBoard.partial: Some sources are incomplete or unavailable. Check source freshness above.
projectBoard.taskNote: Task counts are not a project completion estimate.
projectBoard.snapshotOnly: Collected snapshot, not a live tracker connection
projectBoard.title: Project portfolio
projectBoard.intro: Outcomes across trackers, not a list of tasks or sessions.
projectBoard.readonly: Read-only snapshots. Open the source tracker to change project status. Refresh reloads collected snapshots; it does not sync trackers.

operations.title: Operations map
operations.intro: One work graph. Different lenses. Explore outcomes, roles, and the runs behind them.
operations.inferenceNotice: Preview includes unconfirmed associations. Counts may change; this does not accept or save suggestions.
operations.legend: Solid = observed link · Dashed = inferred link · Gray = unknown. Select a node for evidence. At most 40 nodes shown.
operations.heatmapHelp: Distinct linked runs, not utilization or productivity. A run can have multiple roles; do not sum columns. Up to 30 agents × 20 roles.
operations.limit: Manual-refresh snapshots. Tracker “Done” is reported status, not verified acceptance. Weighted progress, schedule variance, ETA and live token rates are unavailable. Topics come from explicit labels; this is not semantic embedding clustering.
operations.failed: Unable to load the graph and privacy settings. Nothing is displayed.
operations.summary: {sources} sources · {runs} runs unlinked in this view · {suggestions} suggested associations
operations.runCount: {runs} linked runs · {blocked} blocking links · {review} tasks in review
operations.select: Select a cluster or node to inspect evidence.

atlas.intro: Start with everything visible in this runtime. Open a stack, regroup, and zoom into the work. Search is optional.
atlas.inferredNotice: Unconfirmed associations included as a preview. No assignments are saved.
atlas.detailLoaded: Session details responded. No text summary is available.
atlas.detailFailed: Session summary unavailable or timed out. Metadata remains available. Retry when ready.
atlas.failed: Unable to load sessions or privacy settings. Nothing is displayed. Retry refresh.
atlas.coverage: Catalog: {loaded} of {total} loaded · {visible} visible after privacy rules · {state} · observed {time}
atlas.matches: {n} matching sessions / {all} visible in this snapshot
atlas.graphStatus: Optional work-graph source: {state}. Sessions do not require tracker setup.
atlas.empty: No matching sessions. Clear filters or refresh a loading catalog.
atlas.select: Select any session to inspect its metadata and relationships.
atlas.limit: Catalog snapshot for this runtime, not the whole fleet. Activity is not task completion. Token counts are lifetime totals, not burn rates. Unknown relationships remain unassigned.
